title: 我的底片有你的手指
subject: a young man develops the roll from the old film camera his girlfriend borrowed on a Hualien coast trip and finds that all twenty-four frames have the tip of her thumb in the corner, and he asks the lab to print them all
caption: Taiwan Amis-style polyphonic harmony pop, gently swaying 4/4 with long sustained drone-like vocal harmonies and an east-coast setting. a stack of close-voiced sung vocal harmony layers from the lead's own overdubbed voices in parallel intervals, nylon-string guitar picking a rolling pattern, a small hand-held log drum and soft bamboo-clapper pulse, a warm upright bass on the roots, a light acoustic piano on the pre-chorus. airy open-air acoustic mix, voices wide and natural with light room ambience, no drum kit. female lead with male and female overdubbed harmony voices holding long drone-like intervals beneath her, warm natural tone, clearly sung words. Clear full voice, every word enunciated, steady sung melody on every line. 100 BPM, D major. tender, playful, open mood. No rap, no autotune, no electronic drums, no synth pads, no electric guitar.
lyrics:
[Intro - harmony voices and nylon guitar]

[Verse 1]
花蓮的小店 沖底片
老闆把相紙 攤在桌上
二十四張 海 還有山
每一張 都有一個手指

[Pre-Chorus]
左下角 粉紅色的
是你的拇指 蓋住了鏡頭

[Chorus]
我的底片 有你的手指
海在後面 你在前面
你說 我拍壞了
我說 全部都洗出來

[Verse 2]
第一張 它蓋住半個太陽
第二張 它蓋住一隻船
第十張 你笑著回頭
拇指還在 我也還在

[Chorus]
我的底片 有你的手指
海在後面 你在前面
你說 我拍壞了
我說 這樣才最像你

[Bridge - voices alone, held intervals]
下次換我拿相機
我的手指 也要進去

[Chorus]
我的底片 有你的手指
海在後面 你在前面
二十四張 掛滿了牆
你的拇指 比海還大

[Outro - nylon guitar and voices, soft]
老闆說 這捲 免費加洗
